As a fan of RAYE, I’m really happy that Lisa gave her the opportunity to be part of the song she wrote years ago but wasn’t allowed to release because of her label (which made RAYE’s career impossible). I read that the song reached Lisa’s producer, and when she learned the story behind it, she called RAYE to collaborate.  What makes me happiest is that RAYE will finally earn a share of the royalties since she is the co-producer of the song. She’s an artist who was always used to write for stars like Rihanna and J-Lo and deserves much more recognition than she gets.  The three of them were STUNNING, THEY SERVED, QUEENS.  This will surely be one of the best collaborations of the year.  Thank you LISA, you did justice! ♥️  P.S.: If you liked RAYE, got curious about her, or simply want to support her as an artist, listening to her music would help a lot ♥️. Here’s a link to one of her performances: https://youtu.be/BtdBQ1-fzXM?si=GoO-ImrIfdZyWuFz  P.S. to the P.S.: For those who have doubts about what happened with the original track of Born Again, RAYE left Polydor Records in 2021 after publicly denouncing that the label wouldn't let her release her own album and only used her as a songwriter for other artists. Born Again was leaked after her departure, meaning she didn't receive royalties for that version. After the leak, she never officially re-released the song on her own. The 2025 version is the first official release, even though it had already existed in its leaked form.
